note: Headless Chromium on the build container, 1280×720 at 1×, software canvas: compare numbers with each other, not with an iPad. The preview is stepped at 60 frames a second and every frame is drawn and checked.

checks.name: before discovery: the mountain beside known land is a faint sketch; the forest and the village are not shown at all
every discovered feature ends drawn (mountain, 7 trees, village)
ink pools appeared and drained (one per discovery step; never more than 4 at once)
knowledge rules on every frame: the village is never sketched, nothing is drawn before its cell is revealed, sketches stay within 3 cells of known land, a drawn feature never undraws
the sample pack's ink and reveal masks are used for the mountain and the village; the round tree (no masks) derives its own
world-anchored: mid-animation (an ink pool and inking features), panning two cells moves the wash, the pool and the ink exactly with the land
world-anchored: zooming 2.5 → 1.5 leaves the wash and the ink over the same land (centroid within 0.15 cells)
flying back over explored land: everything stays drawn, no new ink
a place that joins blooms from itself: part-way after 0.45 s, complete and still after 3 s
growing territory spreads outward from its old edge; the land already painted stays painted (no flash)
kind wash reads green-gold, cruel wash rust-charcoal
budget: 40 features found at once → at most 24 animate (the rest fade in), every buffer ≤ 160 px
reduced motion: no pools or rivulets; each feature cross-fades to drawn within 0.3 s; washes fade in without spreading
no pack: the hand-drawn symbols ink in the same way with derived masks
live map: the wash is painted from the real territory (one bloom source per territory source) and stays on home-region land
live map: drawing the wash leaves the campaign save unchanged
live map: occupying a place adds its source and a bloom spreads from it, then settles
live map: a kind dragon's wash is green-gold, a cruel one's rust
nothing written to localStorage by the preview (no saves, no settings)
no page errors

liveMap.note: a repaint happens only when the territory changes (a place joins or is lost, the phase or hoard widens the circle, the rule turns); it is spread over frames at most 6 ms each, the old painting showing meanwhile
